title: Naturality and shifts of inverse-scalar adjunction legs
statement: Let $F:D\to T$ and $U:T\to D$ be functors with integer shift comparisons and an adjunction compatible with these comparisons. Let $T$ be $A[1/t]$-linear, with linear shifts. Then the legs $\eta_L U(t^{-n}1_{FL})$ are natural in $L$ and commute with shifts under the composite comparison.

proof.text: Central scalars commute with every morphism. Apply this under U and combine it with naturality of the adjunction unit.
Move the scalar through the F shift comparison using target linearity and through the U comparison by naturality. Apply the unit shift equation.

theorem scalarLocalizationTelescopeLegLaws
    (A : Type v) [CommRing A] (t : A)
    {D : Type uD} [Category.{vD} D] [HasShift D ℤ]
    {T : Type uT} [Category.{vT} T] [Preadditive T] [HasShift T ℤ]
    [Linear (Localization.Away t) T]
    [∀ k : ℤ, (shiftFunctor T k).Linear (Localization.Away t)]
    (F : D ⥤ T) [F.CommShift ℤ] (U : T ⥤ D) [U.CommShift ℤ]
    (adj : F ⊣ U) [adj.CommShift ℤ] :
    (∀ (K L : D) (f : K ⟶ L) (n : ℕ),
      f ≫ (adj.unit.app L ≫ U.map
        (((IsLocalization.Away.invSelf t : Localization.Away t) ^ n) •
          𝟙 (F.obj L))) =
      (adj.unit.app K ≫ U.map
        (((IsLocalization.Away.invSelf t : Localization.Away t) ^ n) •
          𝟙 (F.obj K))) ≫ U.map (F.map f)) ∧
    (∀ (L : D) (n : ℕ) (k : ℤ),
      (adj.unit.app (L⟦k⟧) ≫ U.map
        (((IsLocalization.Away.invSelf t : Localization.Away t) ^ n) •
          𝟙 (F.obj (L⟦k⟧)))) ≫
          ((F ⋙ U).commShiftIso k).hom.app L =
      (adj.unit.app L ≫ U.map
        (((IsLocalization.Away.invSelf t : Localization.Away t) ^ n) •
          𝟙 (F.obj L)))⟦k⟧')
